summary: The change implements Array.prototype.pop in prototype_pop.rs and follows the spec steps in order. ToObject and LengthOfArrayLike come first. The length-0 branch performs Set(obj, "length", +0, true) and returns undefined. Otherwise it computes newLength = length - 1, builds the index key, does Get, then DeletePropertyOrThrow, then Set on "length", and returns the element. Every abstract operation is called with `?`, so errors propagate. There are no test-shaped branches, no hardcoded values, and no swallowed errors. The renaming of `args` and `new_target` to underscore-prefixed names is needed because the old `let _ = (...)` line was removed, so it is not unrelated churn. The gate report (46 runs, 0 regressions, 38 newly passing) fits a change of this size. I have no defect to report.
